title: no min max length names places
rule: No min/max length on names and places — one-character given names and 50-character place names exist. Dual-cite USWDS “raise the DB limit” / character-count not as a cap.

citation.source: NL Design System — Geen min/max lengte

pass_when: Unconstrained name and place fields have no rejecting `minLength`/`maxLength`.
fail_when: `minLength`/`maxLength` rejects a one-character name or a long toponym.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Character-count component; USWDS raise-the-cap as a merge.
